notes: 5.61.0 shipped with six failing assertions across four suites. The code it shipped was sound; the guards that police it were not, and nobody noticed because of how the battery was read, not what it said. The harness reported every failure — in a Failures section — and exited 1. The person running it grepped stdout for a | FAIL | table row and never checked the exit code, so a failure reported anywhere else was invisible.
